english.title: Goods vehicle operator carry commercial goods between member states in breach of posting requirements

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE TYPE AND INDEX MARK..), without reasonable excuse, used that vehicle on a commercial journey for the carriage of goods

(A)_[between member States,]_
(B)_[within a member State,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY STATE OR STATES..), when the conditions specified in regulation 22 of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024 were not satisfied in relation to the use of that vehicle in that manner in that

(C)_[you did not submit a posting declaration at or before the time the journey commenced]_
(D)_[during the journey the driver of the vehicle did not carry a copy of the posting declaration]_
(E)_[you did not submit a posting declaration at or before the time the journey commenced and during the journey the driver of the vehicle did not carry a copy of the posting declaration]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(2) and 27(1)(a) and (6) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024.
